svg.text: Lift pin bore perpendicularity to Datum A
Vacuum port sealing face (flat, masked, Ø18–
M6 tapped holes (Ring upper circuit), Ø302 B
M5 tapped depth (into Heater Plate side)
1. INTERPRET PER ASME Y14.5-2018. UNITS mm. UNLESS NOTED: X.X ±0.2, X.XX ±0.05.
2. BREAK ALL EDGES 0.2-0.4 UNLESS NOTED. NO BURRS.
3. VENT ALL BLIND HOLES IN VACUUM-EXPOSED PARTS PER DR-6 (spec/00).
4. PROVENANCE: EVERY DIMENSION TRACES PER THE SIDECAR PROVENANCE FILE OF THIS DRAWING (AIEF).
5. COOLANT CHANNEL PER MDR-001; RIB 5.0 CONFIRMED (ECR-Q-011 DEC-03): FSW RIB PASSES — TAPERED PROBE TIP ⌀≤4.0, TRACKING ≤±0.5, PENETRATION 6.5–7.0.
6. FSW LID PER spec/01 §6 STEP 5; RADIOGRAPH PER PROCESS NOTES.
7. CLOCKING PER spec/00 §3.2 — BINDING; DO NOT RE-CLOCK.
8. 2× M6×12 BRACKET TAPS AT r=150, 88°/122°, BOTTOM FACE (CP-IF-8 AS AMENDED, APR-031).
